annotations.description: Valid {{ $labels.signal }} records are failing to append, usually because the object store is unavailable or publication is overloaded. Senders retry, so nothing is lost yet, but their queues are growing.

annotations.summary: Pulso has been rejecting {{ $labels.signal }} for an hour
annotations.description: Pulso drops records it cannot store (invalid labels, native histograms or exemplars that are disabled, out-of-retention timestamps). Senders do not retry them. Check the senders' failed-sample metrics for the cause.
Accepted {{ $labels.signal }} over the last 12 hours is more than twice the previous week's rate. Storage and query costs grow with it; look for new high-cardinality labels or verbose services.
Accepted {{ $labels.signal }} over the last 12 hours is less than half the previous week's rate. A sender may have stopped shipping.

annotations.summary: More than 5% of object-store requests are failing
annotations.description: Ingest, queries and maintenance all depend on the object store. Conditional-write conflicts are not counted here.
Bytes written to the object store over the last 12 hours are more than twice the previous week's rate; storage cost follows.
Object-store requests over the last 12 hours are more than twice the previous week's rate; request charges follow. Heavier queries, live tails or compaction backlogs are common causes.
More than 100 callers have waited on manifest publication for 15 minutes on one instance. Ingest acknowledgements slow down until it drains.
Small segments accumulate while compaction cannot finish, which raises query and request costs over time.

annotations.summary: A retention-managed scope is above 80% of its metadata capacity
annotations.description: Appends to a scope fail once its metadata is full. Shorten the retention or compact; see docs/retention.md.

annotations.summary: A retention-managed scope is above 95% of its metadata capacity
annotations.description: Appends to the scope are about to fail. See docs/retention.md.

annotations.summary: Keyed appends were rejected because stored bytes differ
annotations.description: A sender retried an idempotency key with different content, or writers disagree on encoding. See docs/keyed-ingestion.md.

annotations.summary: No Pulso instance is reporting metrics
annotations.description: Every Pulso instance is down or unreachable by the scraper. If these metrics are stored in Pulso itself, this alert only fires through the alerting system's no-data handling.
Work is waiting for CPU on at least one instance; query deadlines and ingest latency suffer. Add CPU or instances.

annotations.summary: More than 10% of queries are failing
annotations.description: Includes queries over their budgets and deadlines. Dashboards and alerts that depend on them show errors or no data.

annotations.summary: Native alert evaluation is being skipped ({{ $labels.reason }})
annotations.description: Only relevant when Pulso's native alerting is enabled. See docs/alerting.md.
